description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Ohio Revised Code — Ohio state statutes — by citation. "ORC 2903.02" is section 2903.02 (murder). Returns the statutory text and its effective date. Keyless. Use for "what does Ohio Revised Code 2903.02 say", "text of ORC 4511.19", or to check an Ohio statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2903.02" or "4511.19". Title and chapter are encoded in the number.

name: oh_revised_code
title: Oh Revised Code
